title: Effect of final methods on inheritance
answer: A final instance method is inherited and can be called normally, but subclasses cannot override it. This is useful when the superclass must preserve one behavior or invariant across the hierarchy. AeroTopo declares `Product.id()` as final, so every Product subtype exposes identity using the same implementation. The restriction improves consistency but reduces extension flexibility, so final should protect a deliberate design rule rather than be applied automatically.
